title: Compact-support exchange in the supplied operation coordinates
statement: Fix the finite-field setting and category of finite-type schemes over the specified algebraic closure in [def-sf-operation-stages]. Let $\mathscr B(X)$ be a family of categories, $S$ a supplied operation stage on this family, $T_X$ its supplied tensor bifunctors, and $Q$ a compactified Cartesian square with arrows $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ and its two compactifications $c,c'$. Let $A$ be exchange-stage data realizing the specified exchange and projection constructions [def-exchange-projection] on these operations, as in [def-sf-operation-stages]. Put $C=A.\mathrm{stage}.\mathrm{compactSupport}$, $H=A.\mathrm{stage}.\mathrm{horizontal}$, $H'=A.\mathrm{stage}.\mathrm{horizontal}'$ and $C'=A.\mathrm{stage}.\mathrm{compactSupport}'$. The given stage has its specified compact exchange $e:H\circ C\to C'\circ H'$. Let $\alpha:H\circ C\xrightarrow{\sim}S(g)^*\circ S(f,c)_!$ and $\beta:C'\circ H'\xrightarrow{\sim}S(f',c')_!\circ S(g')^*$ be the equality isomorphisms induced by the recorded compactSupport, horizontal, horizontal' and compactSupport' equalities. Define the compact-support exchange in operation coordinates to be the natural transformation $S(g)^*\circ S(f,c)_!\to S(f',c')_!\circ S(g')^*$ given by $\beta\circ e\circ\alpha^{-1}$. This is only a re-expression of the given canonical compact exchange through its recorded equalities; it chooses no new map and asserts no invertibility or base-change theorem.
